Name: Farm Tablet
Author: boneskull
Description:
[size=5]Farm Tablet - A portable Farm Computer[/size]

This mod adds a new tool to the game: the [b]iFarmer[/b]. 

When you use the [b]iFarmer[/b], it does the same thing that a [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Farm_Computer]Farm Computer[/url] does.

[i]However[/i], unlike a Farm Computer, the [b]iFarmer[/b] is [i]portable[/i].

[i]Yes[/i], your dreams [i]have[/i] come true.

[size=4]How do I get an iFarmer?[/size]

Once you've unlocked the Farm Computer, the [b]iFarmer[/b] is purchaseable from Robin for 20,000g.

This is only the default behavior, and can be changed via the mod configuration.

[size=4]Configuration[/size]

You can configure this mod by editing the [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] file in the mod's folder, or (recommended) by using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].

[size=3]Configuration Options[/size]

[list]
[font=Courier New]RequireFarmComputerRecipe[/font] (default: [font=Courier New]true[/font]): If [font=Courier New]false[/font], then the [b]iFarmer[/b] will be available for purchase from Robin from the start of the game.[/list]

[size=4]Requirements[/size]
[url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] v3.0.0+
